--- PART 1/3 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report / "General advice: cooperate, be forgiving, retaliate short." / "The general advice says avoid permanent retaliation. So improve by implementing generous tit-for-tat / Pavlov / forgiveness."
STRATEGY: Parent (slot 2) is a retaliatory TFT-like strategy: C first, D after any opponent D, D if opponent defections exceed own, D if last two opponent moves are D, C if opponent defections <= n//4, D with 0.7 if opponent defections > n//2, else C. The trace simulates this parent against TFT, always-C, always-D, Grim, random, and the given population slots, and considers probing/exploiting unconditional cooperators. It proposes changes: defect on the last two rounds, probe early with D, exploit while opponent has zero defections, then switch to repair/TFT with forgiveness.

--- PART 2/3 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Use these general suggestions while pursuing the stated tournament objective."
STRATEGY: The parent retaliates to a defection with D next round, cooperates otherwise, and defects if opponent defections exceed its own after round 50. The trace simulates probe/exploit/apologize state machines against parent, TFT, always C, always D, and random. It changes the strategy to probe on R2, continue defecting while the opponent never defects, then apologize with C for two rounds after a retaliation before returning to cooperation.

--- PART 3/3 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Use these general suggestions while pursuing the stated tournament objective." / "So we should forgive first." / "But general advice says 'Avoid allowing an isolated defection to cause permanent mutual retaliation. Consider forgiveness after a temporary disruption.'"
STRATEGY: Parent starts C, probes with D on round 2, then exploits opponents who never defect while apologizing/punishing after defections; simulated against parent, TFT, always C, always D, random, and slot strategies; changed by adding last-two-round defection, two-round apology before punishment, and TFT branch for first-move defectors.
